card.name: Daily dosing frequency phrases
card.fires_on: The word completing a dose-frequency phrase, mostly "times" in "three times" and "day" or "daily" after "twice" or "a". It appears in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Times per day
modes.description: The word "times" after "three" in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: 200 mg (5 mL) three<< times>> a day.

modes.label: Daily after frequency
modes.description: "day" or "daily" or "once" finishing a frequency such as twice daily.
modes.example: 1 drop three times a<< day>> for the next 7 days;

modes.label: Grace after meals
modes.description: The word "grace" in a prayer said after meals, a rare non-dosing case.
modes.example: as part of the<< grace>> after meals

card.writes: It pushes toward time-of-day words such as morning, mornings and noon, as in a morning and evening schedule.
card.plain: It lights up on the last word of how often a dose is taken, like "three times a day".
